concerns.text: FR‑001 ‘download and parse OQMD subset’ has no implementing task; the required data‑download and validation steps (T005, T006a‑d) are either missing or incomplete, leaving the core ingestion requirement uncovered.
Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) is violated: no task creates the required `data/checksums.json` file, breaking reproducibility guarantees.

FR‑010 ‘handle dataset variable gaps’ is not satisfied – T006d’s PCA‑transformer and transformed feature CSVs are absent, and the generated `validation_report.json` lacks required fields per its schema.
FR‑002 baseline NN parameter‑count constraint is orphaned – T012 does not compute or assert the ≤10 000‑parameter limit and the checkpoint `results/models/baseline_nn_arch.pt` is missing.
FR‑003 Deep Ensemble is uncovered – T013b fails to produce the five ensemble checkpoint files (`ensemble_seed_42.pt` … `ensemble_seed_46.pt`).
FR‑004 Monte‑Carlo Dropout is uncovered – tasks T014a‑d do not generate the required dropout model checkpoints nor the inference CSVs, preventing any MC‑Dropout predictions.
FR‑005 Sparse Gaussian Process is uncovered – T015 and T016a do not create `results/models/sparse_gp_model.pt` nor any prediction CSV, so the GP baseline is missing.

SC‑001 calibration accuracy is untestable – the calibration summary artifact (`results/metrics/calibration_summary.csv`) is not produced (T024 unverified), so ECE, interval‑score and sharpness cannot be measured.

SC‑003 screening utility is untestable – the final screening report (`results/screening_results.csv` / `screening_significance.json`) is absent (T030 unverified), leaving the precision‑gain criterion without evidence.
Constitution Principle I seed reproducibility is not consistently demonstrated; tasks do not log or pin random seeds across all training and inference scripts, risking non‑deterministic runs.
FR‑009 hard 5‑hour runtime limit is not enforced in any verified task; although a `Timeout` utility exists (T016c, T025c), no task shows its integration into the end‑to‑end pipeline.

FR‑008 aleatoric vs. epistemic decomposition is only partially addressed – none of the model scripts (T012, T013b, T014) contain functions that compute or output separate variance components as required.

Task IDs T006a, T006c, T006d reference a single file `code/data/preprocess.py` but the description splits functionality across three distinct steps; this creates ambiguous traceability and may lead to stale or duplicated implementation effort.
